title: Please stop wasting your money on these 3 things!  Part 1 of the ACTU...
description: Please stop wasting your money on these 3 things!  Part 1 of the ACTUAL business advice I would give my younger business self, and I genuinely wish someone had pulled me aside years ago and told me this. The 3 things I’d stop spending cashflow on: 1.	Trying to look “bigger” than you are (events, PR, the 7-figure flex) 2.	Outsourcing your ads to marketing agencies 3.	Bulk-buying stock before you’ve tested product market fit Each one of these cost me money I didn’t need to spend, and took energy and time away from the things that actually mattered! The more you know, with @nab  who I’ve teamed up with for a 3-part series sharing my business learnings. Part 2 + 3 dropping soon.  #YourPartnerForEveryStage #Sponsored
